title: The numbers to memorize
idea: A handful of numbers the exam asks for directly. Each one is paired with a near miss.

rows: How early you can request renewal
Grace period after it expires (but no transmitting)
Give your call sign at least this often, and at the end
Higher than this, a station is a space station
Minimum for a club station license

pairs: How often to give your call sign

compare.how: 2 years to renew. You still can't transmit until it's renewed.
Transmit once the grant appears in the FCC database.

traps.why: You can ask for renewal up to 90 days before expiration.

traps.wrong: Immediately on receiving your Certificate of Successful Completion of Examination (CSCE)
traps.why: For a first license, wait until the grant appears in the FCC's license database.

traps.wrong: Yes, for up to two years
traps.why: The grace period is for renewing, not for operating. No transmitting until it's renewed.

traps.wrong: At least every 15 minutes during and at the end of a communication
traps.why: It's every 10 minutes, and at the end.

traps.wrong: Never, the tactical call is sufficient
traps.why: Tactical calls are fine, but you still give your FCC call sign every 10 minutes and at the end.
A space station is an amateur station more than 50 km above the Earth.

traps.wrong: The trustee must have an Amateur Extra Class operator license grant
traps.why: No license class requirement. The club needs at least four members.
